title: Metadata spine: TMDB + AniList clients and the artwork cache
spec: GET /api/search?q= returns ranked candidates from TMDB multi-search: title, year, kind (anime/movie/live-action), overview, poster and backdrop URLs, tmdb_id, media_type. Kind inference: TMDB genre 16 + origin JP => anime, else tv => live-action, else movie. GET /api/titles/{tmdb_id}/details enriches with imdb_id (from TMDB external_ids — IMDb has no free API, this is the only source) and, for anime, AniList (studio, season, episode count, romaji + English titles; no key needed). Artwork is DOWNLOADED to data/art/ and served by the backend, never hotlinked and never placed in Vite public/ — data/ is gitignored because cached art reveals the list. Cache is content-addressed and re-fetch is a no-op. Handle rate limits and a missing/invalid key with a real error, not a crash. ACCEPT: searching 'cowboy bebop' returns the 1998 anime, the 2021 live-action and the 2001 film as three distinct candidates with distinct posters; details on the 1998 one yields an imdb_id and AniList studio data.

refine.evidence: Spec artifact at .autodev/specs/T-3.md, 9 testable ACs. AC3 is the headline test and is stated as a concrete expectation rather than a description: 'cowboy bebop' must yield the 1998 anime, the 2021 live-action and the 2001 film as three distinct candidates with three distinct posters and source ids. AC2 states the kind-inference rule precisely enough to fail a wrong implementation (TMDB genre 16 AND (origin_country JP OR original_language ja) => anime). AC7 and AC8 exist because Evan has not supplied IGDB credentials yet: search must degrade to screen-only rather than break, and the Twitch token must be fetched once and cached, proven by counting token requests. AC6 forbids handing the frontend a remote URL and forbids writing art into the public tree — the privacy boundary from T-2 carried forward. Carries the video-games amendment from kb/CURRENT-WORK.md, written into the spec here rather than patched in later.

locate.evidence: LOCATE at .autodev/locates/T-3.md. Maps exactly what T-2 already provides so this ticket adds no plumbing it does not need: config already types the three credentials as str|None (AC7's degrade is a truthiness check), the /api router is already included ahead of the SPA catch-all, /art is already mounted on art_dir so AC6 only needs the writing half, and the schema already models source/source_id/nullable imdb_id/detail so no migration is required. Carries forward T-2's handed-on regression: adding routes means re-running the traversal check at verify. Upstream facts were confirmed by reading the APIs rather than recalled: search/multi carries origin_country on tv but original_language on movies (which is WHY AC2's rule is an OR); external_ids is a separate call so AC4's second round trip is by necessity; TMDB returns path fragments not URLs; AniList has no id mapping from TMDB so anime enrichment is a fuzzy title match; IGDB uses apicalypse POST bodies and templated cover image_ids. Three risks recorded: fuzzy AniList matches must decorate and never replace a TMDB title; images must NOT be downloaded during search because search is typed-into; and the token cache file needs 0600 and must stay inside gitignored data/.

plan.evidence: PLAN at .autodev/plans/T-3.md: 6 steps, each mapped to the ACs it satisfies. Records one deliberate reading of the spec rather than resolving it silently — AC6 says the response never hands the frontend a remote URL, but downloading artwork during a typed-into search would pull megabytes per keystroke, so the cache is filled at details/add time and the candidate LIST carries remote URLs. That reading is written down for review to accept or reject. Also records: AniList decorates and may never change title/year/kind (locate risk 1), and each source is awaited independently so one dying returns the other's results plus a named error rather than an empty list that reads as 'no matches'.

build.evidence: BUILT — evidence at .autodev/evidence/T-3/build-and-review.md. AC3 (headline) passes against the live API: 'cowboy bebop' returns the 1998 anime tmdb:30991, the 2021 live-action tmdb:84469 and the 2001 film tmdb:11299 — three kinds, three ids, three posters. AC2 proven against 7 named titles including Toy Story correctly filed as movie, which is the case genre-16-alone would have failed. AC4: tmdb/30991 gave imdb_id tt0213338 plus AniList studio Sunrise, Spring 1998, 26 episodes; The Thing gave tt0084787 with NO AniList decoration. AC6: 4 content-addressed files in data/art/, repeat request produced no new files and byte-identical contents, /art/ serves 200 image/jpeg. AC7/AC9 proven by corrupting the key (named error, not an empty list) and by emptying it (503 with an actionable message, health still 200). AC8 proven with a stubbed transport: 5 token() calls -> 1 exchange, 0600 cache, 60-day expiry, force-refresh and expired-cache paths both work. AC1 IGDB half and AC5 live are UNPROVEN pending Evan's Twitch credentials — stated plainly in the evidence, not implied complete. Files: backend/sources/{base,tmdb,igdb,anilist}.py, backend/artwork.py, and /api/search + /api/details on backend/main.py.

auto-review.evidence: REVIEWED — 2 findings, both in this ticket's own code, both fixed and re-verified; written up in .autodev/evidence/T-3/build-and-review.md. (1) SILENT WRONG ANSWER: tmdb.details() guessed between the movie and tv namespaces when the caller gave no media_type. TMDB ids are namespace-scoped, so this did not fail — it returned a different plausible title: /api/details/tmdb/30991 returned 'The Curse of the Living Corpse' (1964) instead of Cowboy Bebop, and /api/details/tmdb/550 with a tv hint returned 'Till Death Us Do Part' instead of Fight Club. Wrong title, wrong poster, wrong IMDb id, and T-4 would have persisted it. Fixed to refuse rather than guess; the resulting obligation on T-4 (persist media_type with any stored TMDB title) is recorded in kb/CURRENT-WORK.md so it survives the ticket boundary. (2) Every SourceError was wrapped as 502, so a caller mistake read as an upstream outage; fixed to pass 400/404 through while 401/429/5xx still become 502 — re-verified: missing media_type 400, bad id 404, unknown source 404, good request 200. T-2's handed-forward traversal regression re-run because this ticket added routes: ../../.env and ../../.git/config both return the SPA shell with 0 secrets.
